tasks.title: Daily Customer Follow-up Agent
tasks.description: Scan unanswered Prime Inbox conversations older than 12 hours and draft contextual responses.
tasks.system_prompt: Review unanswered customer conversations older than 12 hours. Draft a concise, helpful response using customer and order context. Never send automatically; save each response as a draft for agent review.

tasks.title: Nightly Stock Audit & Alert
tasks.description: Check low-stock SKUs across physical warehouses and alert the operations team.
tasks.system_prompt: Audit ATP across every physical warehouse. Identify SKUs below their reorder point, group them by warehouse and severity, then send a concise alert through Slack and email.

tasks.title: Weekly Abandoned Cart Digest
tasks.description: Compile abandoned PrimeWeb checkouts and assign qualified opportunities to sales agents.
tasks.system_prompt: Find abandoned PrimeWeb checkouts from the previous seven days. Rank by customer value and purchase intent, summarize likely blockers, and assign follow-up tasks to the appropriate sales owner.

logs.result_summary: Reviewed 28 conversations and created 8 response drafts.
Stock audit stopped before notifications were delivered.
